display.label: DNS A Record
display.description: Azure DNS A Record for mapping domain names to IPv4 addresses or alias target resources

resource.key_description: The name of the DNS A Record (use '@' for zone apex or a subdomain label like 'www'). Serves as the map key.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core DNS A Record name, zone, and resource group placement.

fields.label: Record Name
fields.description: The relative name of the DNS A Record. Use '@' for the zone apex or a subdomain label like 'www' or 'api'. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

validation.pattern_error: Must be '@' or between 1 and 63 alphanumeric characters, hyphens, or underscores.

fields.label: DNS Zone Name
fields.description: The name of the parent DNS Zone where the record will be created (e.g., example.com). Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

validation.pattern_error: Must be a valid domain name (e.g., example.com).

fields.label: Resource Group Name
fields.description: The name of the Resource Group in which the parent DNS Zone exists. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

validation.pattern_error: Resource Group name must be 1-90 characters (alphanumerics, underscores, parentheses, hyphens, periods) and cannot end in a period.

sections.label: Routing & Target Configuration
sections.description: TTL, IPv4 addresses, or alias target resource configuration.

fields.label: TTL (seconds)
fields.description: The Time To Live (TTL) of the DNS record in seconds.

fields.label: IPv4 Addresses
fields.description: List of IPv4 addresses for this A record. Mutually exclusive with Target Resource ID.

fields.label: Target Resource ID (Alias Record)
fields.description: The Azure resource ID of the target resource (such as an Azure Public IP) to create an alias record. Mutually exclusive with IPv4 Addresses.

sections.label: Tags
sections.description: Resource tags for organization, governance, and billing.

fields.label: Tags
fields.description: Key-value pairs to tag the DNS A Record for organization and governance.
